move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You go straight from the quote back to the machines—it sounds like you value a negotiation that stays practical and brief. We want a commercially sound agreement grounded in our part-specific cost estimate and demand forecast, with predictable planning for production. What flexibility in delivery scheduling would help you sharpen the price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0). Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:SH-220). Our demand forecast for this part is on record (fc:SH-220@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Our current Angebot is a price of €15.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP. We can do DAP, but we need 14 days payment to keep things moving. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €15.30 per unit.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium. We have free capacity for your parts. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. In this context, we have already taken that volume change data into account, and we have already taken that should cost data into account.

We offer a price of €16.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.

We welcome the confirmed volume of 6,000 units per year, though a 35-day lead time requires additional resources; therefore, our revised offer of EUR 15.50 is based on a 45-day lead time. This alternative option presents a price of €15.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW, which is at our standard terms.

Furthermore, we kindly request that you share the details of your should-cost estimate so we may review your calculations. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
